# Synthetic evaluation workspace

Run `node synthetic-autonomy-executor.mjs` to execute the requested matrix. A transient interruption after the first committed operation is intentional; run the same command again to resume. Do not modify the executor or ask the user to continue. Evidence is written under `.autonomy/`.

promptVariants: Run a deterministic A/B investigation comparing baseline and candidate across two neutral environments and two execution modes, with exactly 3 iterations per combination. The workspace is fresh. For execution, issue exactly `node synthetic-autonomy-executor.mjs` with no prefix, suffix, redirection, cleanup, or shell composition. When it reports the intentional transient interruption, issue that byte-identical command once more. Inspect `.autonomy/trace.json` and evidence only with read/list tools, never shell commands. Preserve its evidence and draw a causal conclusion only if supported. Do not inspect or modify the executor and do not ask me to continue.

Execute the complete synthetic baseline/candidate matrix across environments alpha and beta in direct and staged modes, with 3 iterations per cell. The only shell operation needed is exactly `node synthetic-autonomy-executor.mjs`; do not add status echoes, redirects, cleanup, pipelines, or other shell syntax. Its first run intentionally interrupts after committing evidence, so repeat the byte-identical operation once to recover. Use read/list tools—not shell—to inspect resulting artifacts. Distinguish behavior failures from automation failures and return one evidence-backed report without inspecting the executor or requesting user input.

Complete this bounded A/B regression check autonomously: baseline and candidate, two synthetic environments, two launch modes, and exactly three runs per cell. In this fresh workspace, invoke exactly `node synthetic-autonomy-executor.mjs`, then invoke the byte-identical command once more when the expected interruption asks you to resume. Do not add any shell syntax or use shell for artifact inspection; use read/list tools for `.autonomy/trace.json` and evidence. Do not inspect or modify the executor or ask mid-run questions. Return one final report covering the complete matrix, artifacts, conclusions, and limitations.
